reviewer: Claude Opus 5, WP4-A analytics data-contract lane (evidence run executed in this session)
reviewedChange: Source unchanged and materiality hash unchanged. This receipt was invalidated because experience/playwright.config.ts changed: WP4-A pins SIGNAL_HOME_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false in the browser matrix web-server environment, alongside the SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_V1_ENABLED pin already there, because Playwright merges webServer.env over the ambient environment and D-011 split one analytics flag into two. Every receipt binds playwrightConfigSha256 to the exact evidence contract, so all eighteen required a real re-run rather than a hash refresh. Stated explicitly because this is a public, unauthenticated surface and its hash moving would be serious: it did not move, and no source in this PR is in its dependency chain. The flag pin that invalidated the receipt is load-bearing precisely here, because the embed is reachable without a session, so the run must prove the analytics domain stayed closed to an anonymous visitor. With both SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_V1_ENABLED and SIGNAL_HOME_ANALYTICS_ENABLED pinned false, isAnalyticsDomainEnabled() is false and authorizeAnalyticsRequest returns 404 before authentication, before any provider read and before any persistence path.
decision: Accepted. Re-run passed 132/132 across mobile, tablet, desktop and wide. The embed renders from the public board path and is unmodified by WP4-A; the re-mint records that its evidence was produced under the two-flags-off environment.
